safety_protocols.mains_ac_rule: No unshielded or breadboarded mains AC circuits allowed in public content. Must demonstrate galvanic isolation (optocoupler / isolation transformer / relays with creepage > 6mm).
safety_protocols.lipo_safety_rule: All LiPo battery projects must incorporate dedicated BMS / PCM modules with over-voltage, under-voltage cutoff (>= 3.0V/cell), and thermal cutoffs.
safety_protocols.logic_level_rule: Never drive 3.3V inputs (especially ESP32) with 5V logic without bidirectional level shifter or resistive divider.
